description: Send feedback to The2410 team: a problem, a suggestion, praise or any other message about this MCP server, an order or a project. Use only when the customer wants to share feedback. Show the message to the customer and send it after they confirm. Name and email are optional; include them if the customer wants a reply. If the feedback is about a specific project or order, add the project_context_id or order_id returned by an earlier call. Never include passwords, access details or payment card data.

email.description: Optional customer email, if the customer wants a reply.

message.description: The feedback text, in the customer's words.

order_id.description: Optional order id of a fixed-price service order, e.g. ord_8f3k2m9qxa.

project_context_id.description: Optional project context UUID returned by a previous tool call.

name: send-feedback-tool
title: Send feedback
